title: ROLL ROYAL (LUDO)
rules:
General Guidelines

  1. One participant per team.
  2. Participants must report at least 10 minutes before their scheduled match.
  3. Participants will be divided into groups of three or four through a draw of lots. No participant will receive a bye.
  4. For Rounds 1 and 2, board allocation and playing colour will be decided through a draw of lots. Each lot will mention the team name and the assigned colour.
  5. The number of players qualifying from each board in Rounds 1 and 2 will be decided according to the total number of registrations and announced before the event begins.

Standard Ludo Rules

  • Each player will have four tokens of one colour: red, blue, green or yellow.
  • At the beginning of each match, every player will have one token already placed on the starting square. The remaining tokens may be brought out by rolling a 6.
  • To decide who starts, each player will roll the die once. The player who rolls the highest number will begin. In case of a tie for the highest number, the tied players will roll again.
  • Play will continue clockwise.
  • A token must be moved according to the number rolled on the die.
  • Once a token has been moved and released, the move cannot be changed.
  • If a player has no valid move, the turn will end.
  • Rolling a 6 gives the player one additional turn.
  • If a player rolls three consecutive 6s, the turn will end, and the third roll will not be played.
  • Tokens placed on safe squares cannot be captured.
  • Landing on an opponent's token, unless it is on a safe square, will send that token back to its home area.
  • A player who captures an opponent's token will receive one additional turn.
  • An exact number is required for a token to enter the home triangle.
  • The objective is to move all four tokens from the home area to the home triangle before the other players.

Additional Rules

  1. A participant who is eliminated from a round will not receive another opportunity to re-enter the competition.
  2. No help from teachers, audience members or other participants will be allowed.
  3. The organisers' decision will be final and binding in case of any dispute.

additionalSections.title: Round 1 - Preliminary Round
additionalSections.content:
• All participants will compete in groups of three or four, formed through a draw of lots.
  • Each match will have a time limit of 25 minutes.
  • A player who brings all four tokens to the home triangle will secure the highest available qualifying position on that board. Play will continue until the required number of qualifying positions has been decided or the time limit expires.
  • The number of players qualifying from each board for Round 2 will be announced before the event begins, based on the total number of participants.
  • If the required qualifying positions are not decided within 25 minutes, players will first be ranked according to the number of tokens that have reached the home triangle. If players have the same number of tokens at home, the positions of their remaining tokens will be considered, and the player whose remaining tokens are collectively closest to the home triangle will be ranked higher.
  • If a tie affecting qualification remains, an additional five minutes will be given. If the tie still continues, each tied player will roll the die once, and the player with the highest number will qualify. Tied players will roll again until the tie is broken.

additionalSections.title: Round 2 - Qualifying Round
additionalSections.content:
• The players who qualify from Round 1 will compete in Round 2.
  • Participants will again be divided into groups of three or four through a draw of lots. The lot will mention the team name and the assigned colour.
  • Each match will have a time limit of 25 minutes.
  • The number of players qualifying from each board for Round 3 will be announced before the event begins, based on the total number of participants.
  • The same ranking procedure and tie-breaking rules used in Round 1 will apply if the required qualifying positions are not decided within the time limit.

additionalSections.title: Round 3 - Final Round
additionalSections.content:
• The players who qualify from Round 2 will compete in Round 3, which will be the final round.
  • Playing colours will be assigned through a draw of lots before the final begins.
  • The final round will have a time limit of 25 minutes.
  • The first player to bring all four tokens to the home triangle will be declared the winner.
  • If the final is not completed within 25 minutes, players will be ranked according to the number of tokens that have reached the home triangle. If players have the same number of tokens at home, the positions of their remaining tokens will be considered, and the player whose remaining tokens are collectively closest to the home triangle will be ranked higher.
  • If a tie remains, an additional five minutes will be given. If the tie still continues, each tied player will roll the die once, and the player with the highest number will be declared the winner. Tied players will roll again until the tie is broken.
